verdict: No paid ads ran this period; organic activity is holding the line.
narrative: The last 28 days saw zero paid spend across all channels, which means the August performance scoreboard cannot be evaluated on paid results alone. Organic touchpoints carried all the activity: your Google Business Profile logged 210 actions — 66 calls, 89 direction requests, and 55 website clicks — while Search Console recorded 71 clicks from nearly 7,600 impressions. GBP actions dropped sharply in the final days of the week, a real dip being monitored closely, and the Search Console gain this week was concentrated in a single day rather than a sustained trend. Getting paid campaigns active is the immediate priority so next period has a full picture to report against.
